name: sdlpop
title: SDLPoP 1.23 (Prince of Persia, C, SDL2)
fetch: curl -L https://github.com/NagyD/SDLPoP/archive/refs/tags/v1.23.tar.gz | tar -xz -C corpus; move its data/ and SDLPoP.ini to the data directory
_doc: The 1989 game's DOS executable, disassembled and rewritten in C by David Nagy: seg000.c to seg009.c are the original's code segments. Its sprites are PNG files read through SDL_image, its music is the original's AdLib data played by an OPL3 emulator compiled with the rest (opl3.c), and it mixes its own sound in an SDL audio callback.
